تحتبون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَبُونَ (taḥtabūna) /taħ.ta.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَبَى (iḥtabā)
# تُحْتَبَوْنَ (tuḥtabawna) /tuħ.ta.baw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَبَى (iḥtabā)
